title: Rabbi Benyamin Walters New Class (5784)
translation: Only as Rabbi Walters translates each phrase while he reads it in class, anchored to where he says it; a phrase he reads without translating has no English.

public.permission: Rabbi Benyamin Walters gave permission to publish his study guides publicly, in the app and on the site; applied to the 5784 classes as to the 2020 ones.
